put.summary: Upsert timeslot configuration for a venue
put.description:
Full replacement of venue timeslot configuration, including schedule, flags (capacity/timeslot toggles), and lead time. Creates configuration if it does not exist.

Important: This request replaces the entire configuration. Ensure that you send the full configuration, as missing fields may be lost.

The capacity field for each timeslot is required if `timeslots_capacities_enabled` is set to true.
